name: io.github.tonyyang0504/takealot-mcp
description: Takealot Marketplace (ecommerce channels): me, update_listing, set_inventory, end_listing. Every too

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_TAKEALOT_AUTHORIZATION
environmentVariables.description: The complete Authorization header value for your Seller API key exactly as the Takealot Seller Portal shows it (Seller Portal > API, https://seller.takealot.com/api/seller-api — generate the key there; the public reference only says to 'attach an Authorization header' and defers the format to that page).

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_TAKEALOT_MERCHANT_WAREHOUSE_ID
environmentVariables.description: Your leadtime merchant_warehouse_id (listed at https://seller.takealot.com/api/seller-api/offers); required by set_inventory.
